sloka: बलि षड् भागम् उद्धृत्य नृपस्य अरक्षतः प्रजाः ।अधर्मः यो अस्य सो अस्य अस्तु यस्य आर्यो अनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-२५॥
transliteration: bali ṣaḍ bhāgam uddhṛtya nṛpasya arakṣataḥ prajāḥ ।adharmaḥ yo asya so asya astu yasya āryo anumate gataḥ ॥2-75-25॥

translations.english: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire unrighteousness in the same way as a king who, having received one sixth of the income as tax from people does not protect them
